{{RV|type=function

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.00

|gr1= Tasks

|descr= Shows a task hint. {{Feature|informative| See [[Arma 3: Task Framework]] for more information.}}

|s1= [taskName, taskState] call [[BIS_fnc_taskHint]]

|p1= taskName: [[String]]

|p2= taskState: [[String]] - can be:
*"CREATED"
*"ASSIGNED"
*"SUCCEEDED"
*"FAILED"
*"CANCELED"

|r1= [[Boolean]]

|x1= <sqf>["BIS_task_01","CANCELED"] call BIS_fnc_taskHint;</sqf>

|seealso=  [[Arma 3: Task Framework]]
}}
